intro.uz: Malika Chorsu bozorida meva va sabzavot sotib oladi. Oʻqishdan oldin: bozorda narxni inglizcha qanday soʻraysiz?

paragraphs.en: Malika: Good morning! I want some apples, please. Seller: Good morning! These red apples are very sweet. They are 15,000 sum a kilo.
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Xayrli tong! Menga olma kerak edi. Sotuvchi: Xayrli tong! Mana bu qizil olmalar juda shirin. Ularning kilosi 15 000 soʻm.

paragraphs.en: Malika: Good. Two kilos, please. Do you have any grapes? Seller: Sorry, I don't have any grapes today. But I have some nice pears.
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Yaxshi. Ikki kilo bering, iltimos. Uzumingiz bormi? Sotuvchi: Kechirasiz, bugun uzum yoʻq. Lekin yaxshi noklarim bor.

paragraphs.en: Malika: No, thank you. How much are the tomatoes? Seller: They are 10,000 sum a kilo.
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Yoʻq, rahmat. Pomidor necha pul? Sotuvchi: Kilosi 10 000 soʻm.

paragraphs.en: Malika: One kilo, please. How much is that all together? Seller: That is 40,000 sum.
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Bir kilo bering, iltimos. Hammasi boʻlib qancha boʻldi? Sotuvchi: 40 000 soʻm.

paragraphs.en: Malika: Here you are. Thank you! Seller: Thank you. Come again!
paragraphs.uz: Malika: Mana, oling. Rahmat! Sotuvchi: Sizga ham rahmat. Yana keling!

grammar.example: These red apples are very sweet.

questions.prompt: What does Malika ask for first?

explain.uz: Sotuvchi aytadi: «These red apples are very sweet.»

questions.prompt: The apples are ___ sum a kilo.

explain.uz: «Sorry, I don't have any grapes today.» — bugun uzum yoʻq.

questions.prompt: What does the seller offer instead of grapes?

explain.uz: «But I have some nice pears.» Lekin Malika nok olmaydi.

questions.prompt: How many kilos of tomatoes does Malika buy?

explain.uz: «One kilo, please.» Ikki kilo — bu olma.
«That is 40,000 sum.» — 2 kilo olma 30 000 + 1 kilo pomidor 10 000.
